TEAR_OVERLIMIT.title: Over Limit
TEAR_OVERLIMIT.description:
Gain 3 whenever you play a card, or 6 instead when you play an [gold]Arte[/gold] or [gold]Fonic Hymn[/gold].
Gain 5 at the start of your turn.

At 100, gain [gold]Over Limit[/gold] for 2 turns. During this time, Artes always apply their [gold]Fonon Enhancement[/gold] and you can play any number of Fonic Hymns each turn.
TEAR_ARTE.title: Arte
TEAR_ARTE.description: Gain 6 Over Limit when played. Some Artes gain additional effects when you have the matching [gold]Elemental Fonon[/gold].
TEAR_FONIC_HYMN.title: Fonic Hymn
TEAR_FONIC_HYMN.description: Gain 6 Over Limit when played. Only 1 Fonic Hymn can be played each turn.
